title: OEWD Program Director (Stabilization Fund)
statement: Twelve more households have final approval for stabilization assistance—bringing us to fifty-seven families protected with zero compliance exceptions. The Month-six batch is audit-ready and walking to the Deputy Mayor's desk today, and we're expanding outreach to slipping blocks identified this past cycle. Every approved application moves with certainty.
action: Walking the Month-six disbursement authorization packets to Deputy Mayor Osei's front desk to force the next batch ahead of schedule.
